articles.title: Why Are Orcas Sinking Sailboats? Scientists Have a Wild Theory
articles.summary: A tiny group of orcas has been ramming and sinking sailboats off Spain and Portugal since 2020. Scientists think the whales might be playing — or practicing their hunting skills.

articles.title: Taylor Swift's Touchdown Celebration Goes Viral: 'That's My Husband'
articles.summary: Taylor Swift jumped from her seat and pointed to her wedding ring after Travis Kelce scored his first touchdown of the season. The Chiefs beat the Colts 33-30 in overtime.

articles.title: Southern Taurids Meteor Shower Begins: How to Catch a Fireball
articles.summary: The Southern Taurid meteor shower runs from Sept. 20 to Nov. 20, peaking Oct. 13-14 and Nov. 4-5. It's known for bright fireballs and slow, glowing trails.
